settings.title: Settings
settings.clipboardHintMaster: Copying or revealing a cookie asks for your master password first.
settings.clipboardHintHello: Copying or revealing a cookie asks for Windows Hello first.
settings.moveText: RoALT copies its database to {path} and restarts to use it. The old database is deleted after the restart. Logs and the app's browser data stay in the old folder, so the theme and other view preferences reset.
settings.bandwidthLimited: Roblox's upload is limited to {kbps} kbit/s.
settings.bandwidthStale: Set to {kbps} kbit/s, but Windows has restarted since: apply it again.
settings.bandwidthHint: Caps outbound (upload) traffic only, for all Roblox clients together, as a Windows QoS policy. Applying needs admin rights (Windows asks each time) and lasts until Windows restarts.
settings.shutdownHintClose: Windows' own shutdown timer. When it runs out, Windows closes every app without asking, so unsaved work elsewhere is lost. RoALT's clients are closed 30 s before (if RoALT hasn't restarted since). Cancel it here, even after a restart of RoALT.
settings.shutdownHint: Windows' own shutdown timer. When it runs out, Windows closes every app without asking, so unsaved work elsewhere is lost. Cancel it here, even after a restart of RoALT.
settings.publicHint: On a network Windows calls Public (café, hotel, school Wi-Fi), RoALT doesn't launch or run the web dashboard, and a master-password vault locks.
settings.publicConfirmText: Others on a public network can see which servers your clients connect to, and can try to reach this PC. With this on, RoALT launches and runs the web dashboard there too. Only turn it on for a network you trust, and turn it off again after.
settings.remoteHint: See, launch and close clients from a phone or another PC on your network, in a browser. Anyone on the network with the PIN can launch and close your clients. Runs only while the vault is unlocked.
settings.remoteConfirmText: Anyone on your network who has the PIN can see your clients, launch your accounts and close or kill clients. It never shows cookies or other secrets. Windows Firewall asks to allow RoALT the first time: allow private networks only, never public ones.
settings.backgroundCovers: The theme covers {n}% of the picture
settings.encryptionHintMaster: AES-256-GCM with a key from your master password (Argon2id). Asked at start and after auto-lock.
settings.encryptionHintDpapi: Windows DPAPI: unlocks with your Windows sign-in, no prompt.
settings.antiAfkFocusHint: Each client is brought to the front for a moment and the window you had in front comes back. Only after 5 s without keyboard or mouse input; minimized clients are skipped.
settings.antiAfkBackgroundHint: A Tab press is sent to each client's window without moving the focus, so you can keep using the PC, and minimized clients get it too. Roblox may not count it as activity in every game; auto-rejoin after a disconnect stays the fallback.
settings.publicNotNow: Not on a public network now.
settings.importWrongPassword: Wrong password, or the file is damaged.
settings.bandwidthRange: Use 64 to 10 000 000 kbit/s, or 0 for none
settings.addressHint: Open it on a device on the same network.
settings.addressNotRunning: Not running. Unlock the vault, or pick another port.
settings.certificatePending: Made when the dashboard first starts.
settings.robloxMissing: Roblox isn't installed. Install it here or from roblox.com.
settings.openLogsHint: RoALT's own logs, for a bug report
settings.newPin: New PIN. Every signed-in device has to enter it again.
settings.newCertificateToast: New certificate. Browsers warn once more: check the new fingerprint.
settings.languageHint: Windows follows the Windows display language when RoALT has it, else English.
settings.accentHint: Buttons, switches and highlights. Pick a preset or any colour.
settings.densityHint: Row height in the accounts list.
settings.discordHint: Your Discord profile shows “Playing RoALT” with the game and how many alts run. Only while Discord is open on this PC.
settings.closeToTrayHint: The window hides; running clients and auto-rejoin keep working.
settings.multiHint: RoALT holds Roblox's single-instance lock while it runs, so each account gets its own client. Turn it on before the first client starts.
settings.protectLoginHint: While RoALT's clients run, lock Roblox's shared sign-in files so clients can't overwrite each other's session (error 773, wrong account in game). Meanwhile Roblox's own app can't save its sign-in.
settings.launchDelayHint: Wait between two launches when several accounts launch at once. About a second either way is added.
settings.minimizeHint: Each client is minimized once, when its window first appears, without taking the focus. Anti-AFK in focus mode skips minimized clients; restore one from the Dashboard.
settings.autoRejoinHint: Relaunch a client Roblox disconnects (kicked, server shut down, connection lost) into the same target.
settings.autoRestartHint: Relaunch a client that closes without RoALT closing it, or whose window stops responding for 30 s. Closing Roblox's window yourself looks the same, so close clients from RoALT.
settings.antiAfkHint: So Roblox doesn't disconnect idle clients after 20 minutes, each client in a game gets a key press. A client can opt out under its limits in Launch.
settings.antiAfkEveryHint: Roblox disconnects after 20 idle minutes, so 1 to 19.
settings.breakerHint: Rejoins and restarts of one account within this time. Each waits twice as long as the one before (at most a minute); past the limit RoALT leaves it and tells you.
settings.closeGraceHint: How long a client RoALT closes gets to close by itself before it is ended.
settings.launchArgsHint: Extra words for every client, after its launch link (for a bootstrapper, say). No quotes or & | < > ^. An account can have its own in its details.
settings.fpsCapHint: The frame rate each client RoALT starts is capped at, unless the account has its own. RoALT sets Roblox's own Maximum Frame Rate just before the client starts and puts yours back once the client has read it; a batch does so for each launch. 0 leaves Roblox alone.
settings.lowGraphicsHint: Clients RoALT starts use Roblox's lowest graphics quality, which saves a lot of GPU and CPU with many clients. Your own Roblox graphics setting is put back right after, and again when such a client closes (or, if RoALT isn't running then, when it next starts).
settings.autoUpdateHint: When Roblox has a new version and no Roblox client runs (nor a launch or batch), install it. The installer is checked to be signed by Roblox Corporation first. Never over a bootstrapper such as Bloxstrap, which updates Roblox itself.
settings.memRestartHint: Close and relaunch a client whose private memory stays over this for 30 s, into the same game, within the restart limit above. Not during a batch. 0 turns it off.
settings.memThrottleHint: While a client's private memory is over this, hold it to the CPU limit beside it, which lowers its frame rate. Lifted once it is back under 90 %. Tightens a client's own limit, never loosens it. 0 turns it off.
settings.trimHint: Ask Windows to page each client's memory out on a schedule; it comes back as used. A client's own setting in Launch wins. 0 turns it off.
settings.spreadHint: Give each client its own share of the cores, round-robin. Cores picked for a client in Launch win.
settings.adaptiveHint: Clients whose window isn't in front get the limits below; the one you're playing runs free. A client with its own limits keeps them.
settings.adaptiveBgHint: CPU limit (a share of all cores), efficiency mode and how often to trim memory, for clients not in front.
settings.panicHint: Works from any app, even a game in front: kills every Roblox client at once, like Kill all. Modifiers and one key, like Ctrl+Shift+F12. Empty turns it off.
settings.cleanLogsHint: Delete Roblox's client logs over a day old or over 50 MB, at start and every hour. A running client's log is kept.
settings.masterPasswordHint: Changing it only re-wraps the key; cookies are not re-encrypted.
settings.autoLockHint: Locks the vault and wipes the key from memory.
settings.clipboard: Clear clipboard after copying a cookie
settings.cacheHint: How long the info panel reuses what Roblox said before asking again. Presence refreshes every minute while Accounts is open.
settings.backupHint: One password-protected .roalt file with every account, its cookie and its groups.
settings.aboutHint: RoALT talks to roblox.com, to GitHub to look for its own updates (unless turned off above) and to Discord once you set a webhook, and changes nothing on your PC unless you apply a bandwidth limit. New versions are on GitHub Releases.
settings.setMasterText: RoALT will ask for it at start and after auto-lock. There is no way to recover it; keep a backup.
settings.changeMasterText: Enter the current password, then the new one.
settings.removeMasterText: Cookies will be protected by your Windows account instead and open without a prompt.
settings.removeMasterDone: Master password removed. The vault now opens with Windows.
settings.exportText: The file holds every cookie, encrypted with this password. You need it to import the file.
settings.moveDialog: Choose a folder for RoALT's data
settings.portHint: 1024 to 65535. Changing it restarts the dashboard.
settings.pinHint: Asked once on each device. Regenerating signs every device out.
settings.certificateHint: HTTPS with a certificate RoALT made itself, so the browser warns the first time. Continue only if the certificate it shows has this SHA-256 fingerprint.
settings.selfUpdateHint: Asks GitHub Releases at start and every 6 hours. A new version is offered, never installed without your click, and its installer runs only if it carries RoALT's release signature.
settings.clientInstallHint: Downloads Roblox's installer from setup.rbxcdn.com and runs it once it is verified as signed by Roblox Corporation
settings.backgroundHint: Your own picture behind the app (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 8 MB). It is kept in RoALT's data.
settings.backgroundDim: How much the theme covers the picture
settings.publicBannerAllowed: Public network: launching and the web dashboard are allowed here (Settings, Security). Others on it may see your traffic.
settings.publicBannerBlocked: Public network: launching and the web dashboard are off until you join a private network.
settings.updateConfirmText_one: RoALT closes while it updates and starts again by itself. {count} Roblox client keeps running, and the restarted RoALT follows it again. Its CPU limits are lifted for the few seconds RoALT is closed.
settings.updateConfirmText_other: RoALT closes while it updates and starts again by itself. {count} Roblox clients keep running, and the restarted RoALT follows them again. Their CPU limits are lifted for the few seconds RoALT is closed.

accounts.add.title: Add account
accounts.add.loginIntro: A Roblox sign-in window opens. Sign in as usual: passkeys, security keys and 2-step verification work there. RoALT keeps the session and closes the window by itself.
accounts.add.loginPrivate: The window uses a fresh private browser profile that is deleted afterwards. Close it to cancel.
accounts.add.waiting: Waiting for you to finish signing in…
accounts.add.manyHelp: Every .ROBLOSECURITY cookie in the text is checked with Roblox one by one, so a long list takes a while. Lines like <mono>user:pass:cookie</mono> work too; only the cookie is kept.
accounts.add.ramHint: Its AccountData.json; one locked with a RAM password can't be read
accounts.add.cookieHelp: The raw value or <mono>.ROBLOSECURITY=…</mono> both work. RoALT checks it with Roblox, then keeps it encrypted on this PC. Anyone with this cookie can sign in as you; never paste it anywhere else.
accounts.detail.sessionOpenedValid: Opened a signed-in roblox.com window. Signing out there signs this account out of RoALT too.
accounts.detail.sessionOpenedOther: Opened roblox.com for this account. Sign in or finish the check there; RoALT keeps the new session when you close the window.
accounts.detail.cookieCopied_one: Cookie copied. The clipboard clears in {count} s.
accounts.detail.cookieCopied_other: Cookie copied. The clipboard clears in {count} s.
accounts.detail.launchHint: Pick a target in Launch for this account
accounts.detail.launchDisabled: Only an account with a valid cookie can launch
accounts.detail.openSessionHint: Opens roblox.com signed in as this account, in its own window
accounts.detail.noGroups: No groups yet. Add one in the sidebar.
accounts.detail.allowDisconnectHint: Never rejoined or restarted; a batch counts a disconnect as done.
accounts.detail.muteDiscordHint: No alerts about this account's clients; batch and status summaries still go.
accounts.detail.fpsCapHint: Set when its client starts, 5 to 360. 0 uses the default from Settings.
accounts.detail.cookieHides_one: Hides in {count} s. Never share it: it signs in as this account.
accounts.detail.cookieHides_other: Hides in {count} s. Never share it: it signs in as this account.

accounts.detail.cookieAskHello: Reveal and copy ask for Windows Hello first.

accounts.detail.copyText: Enter your master password to copy the cookie for @{name}.

accounts.emptyText: Sign in through Roblox's own page or paste a .ROBLOSECURITY cookie. Cookies are encrypted and stay on this PC.

launch.joinHint: A friend online, or one of your accounts

launch.placeIdPlaceholder: The game's place ID or link
launch.noAccounts: No accounts yet. Add one in Accounts.
launch.onlyValid: Only an account with a valid cookie can launch
launch.fpsHint: This launch's frame rate cap, for every account in it, instead of each account's own and the default in Settings. 0 leaves those.
launch.autoRejoinHint: Relaunch a client Roblox disconnects (kicked, server shut down, connection lost) into the same target, until Settings > Give up after.
launch.robloxOutdated: Roblox is out of date: its update can close the other clients. Update it in Settings first.
launch.pickValid: Pick an account with a valid cookie.
launch.limits.buttonHint: CPU limit, efficiency mode, trimming and cores
launch.limits.oneCore: Leave at least one CPU core.
launch.limits.trimmed: Trimmed its memory. Windows pages it back in as the client needs it.
launch.limits.help: The limit is a share of all CPU cores; its frame rate drops with it. For a fixed frame rate, use the FPS cap when launching. Efficiency mode lowers its priority, as Task Manager does. Trimming asks Windows to page its memory out; it comes back as used. Limits set here win over the adaptive manager's. Anti-AFK briefly brings this client to the front for a Space press while you're away; it skips a minimized client.
launch.running.title: Running clients
launch.running.empty: Clients you launch show here until they close.
launch.running.fpsLaunch: This launch's FPS cap, set when its client started
launch.running.fpsAccount: This account's FPS cap, set when its client starts
launch.running.relaunchHint: Launch this account into the same game again
launch.running.closeAllText_one: {count} Roblox client RoALT started will close. Unsaved progress in those games is lost.
launch.running.closeAllText_other: {count} Roblox clients RoALT started will close. Unsaved progress in those games is lost.
launch.kill.hint: Hold for a second: ends every Roblox client at once, without saving
launch.multi.turnOnText: Roblox says it doesn't officially support running several clients at once. RoALT only holds the name Roblox's client checks when it starts and never touches the client itself, which Roblox says its enforcement against modified clients doesn't cover. Roblox has broken multi-instance before and may again.
launch.multi.label: Multi-instance
launch.multi.closeText_one: Every running Roblox client closes ({count} process), including ones RoALT didn't start. Unsaved progress in those games is lost.
launch.multi.closeText_other: Every running Roblox client closes ({count} processes), including ones RoALT didn't start. Unsaved progress in those games is lost.
launch.multi.takeOverTitle: Take over from the running Roblox?
launch.multi.takeOverText_one: RoALT closes Roblox's own "already running" marker inside the running client ({count} process) with a standard Windows call, so new clients can start next to it without closing it. Nothing in the client's memory is changed, but this reaches into a running Roblox: if a client misbehaves afterwards, close Roblox instead. Roblox's anti-cheat may see the access.
launch.multi.takeOverText_other: RoALT closes Roblox's own "already running" marker inside the running clients ({count} processes) with a standard Windows call, so new clients can start next to it without closing it. Nothing in the client's memory is changed, but this reaches into a running Roblox: if a client misbehaves afterwards, close Roblox instead. Roblox's anti-cheat may see the access.

dashboard.microKept: Roblox kept this window at {w} × {h}; that is as small as it goes.
dashboard.trimmed: Trimmed its memory. Windows pages it back in as the client needs it.
dashboard.laidOut_one: Laid out {count} client. Minimized ones and ones without a window yet were left as they are.
dashboard.laidOut_other: Laid out {count} clients. Minimized ones and ones without a window yet were left as they are.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Every client RoALT runs. Double-click one to bring it to the front; right-click for more.
dashboard.tileHint: Lay every client out on this monitor so all fit
dashboard.tileMicroHint: Make every client 320 × 240 and lay them out on this monitor
dashboard.previewFpsHint: How often each live preview is redrawn. Higher rates use more CPU, more so with many clients.
dashboard.empty: No clients are running. Clients you launch show here with a live picture of their window.
dashboard.footnote: Previews play live at the frame rate picked above while RoALT is on screen; a minimized client draws nothing. Micro window asks Roblox for a 320 × 240 window; Roblox may keep it bigger. Anti-AFK skips minimized clients.
discord.evLaunchHint: A client got into a game (not after a rejoin, restart or reconnect).
discord.evCrashHint: A client closed without RoALT closing it.
discord.evHangHint: A client's window hasn't responded for 30 s.
discord.evDisconnectHint: Roblox kicked a client, its server shut down or the connection was lost.
discord.evRestartHint: Auto-rejoin or auto-restart launched an account again.
discord.evMemRestartHint: A client was restarted because it used too much memory.
discord.evBreakerHint: RoALT stopped relaunching an account after too many tries.
discord.evBatchDoneHint: How many accounts of a batch made it into the game.
discord.saved: Webhook saved. Send a test to check it.
discord.removed: Webhook removed. RoALT sends nothing to Discord now.
discord.intro: Get told in a Discord channel when a client crashes, gets disconnected or is relaunched. RoALT posts to a webhook you create in the channel's settings (Integrations, Webhooks). Discord is the only place besides Roblox RoALT sends anything to, and only once a webhook is set. Messages name accounts by display name and username; never a cookie, link or log.
discord.setLocked: Set, but the vault is locked. Unlock it to see or change the webhook.
discord.setId: Set (id {id}). The URL is encrypted in the vault; messages go out only while it is unlocked.
discord.notSet: Not set. Paste the webhook URL Discord shows (Copy Webhook URL).
discord.statusSummaryHint: Every so often while clients run: how many, their RAM and CPU. 0 turns it off.
monitor.range: {label}: {min} to {max} over the last {m} min, now {now}
monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.intro: What each client RoALT runs uses, every 2 seconds. Limits are under each client in Launch.
monitor.empty: Clients you launch show here while they run.
monitor.memoryHint: Private memory (what a leak grows); working set in the tooltip
monitor.restartsHint: Rejoins and restarts that led to this client
